nodes.description: UE in state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF
UE starts timer T3510
UE stops timer T3502 if running
UE stops timer T3511 if running
UE starts timer T3519 if SUCI included and timer not running
UE includes stored SUCI in REGISTRATION REQUEST while T3519 is running
AMF sends REGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE
AMF assigns and includes a TAI list in REGISTRATION ACCEPT
UE deletes old TAI list and stores received TAI list
AMF starts timer T3550 if 5G-GUTI or SOR transparent container IE is included
AMF enters state 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED
AMF starts timer T3550 if Operator-defined access category definitions IE, the Extended emergency number list IE, the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE are included
AMF starts timer T3550 if UE has set RCMAP bit and Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE is included
AMF starts timer T3550 if UE is not in NB-N1 mode, has set RACS bit, and UE radio capability ID IE or deletion indication IE is included
AMF marks in UE's 5GMM context that the UE is not allowed to request UAS services
AMF starts timer T3550 and initiates UUAA-MM procedure if conditions are met
AMF stores in the UE 5GMM context that a UUAA procedure is pending
AMF starts timer T3550 if AMF needs to update NSSRG information and UE has set NSSRG bit
AMF starts timer T3550 if UE supports S-NSSAI time validity information and AMF needs to update it
AMF starts timer T3550 if UE supports S-NSSAI location validity information and AMF needs to update it
AMF starts timer T3550 if UE has set NSAG bit and RCMAN bit and NSAG information IE is included
AMF starts timer T3550 if UE supports network slice replacement and AMF determines to provide the mapping information
AMF starts timer T3550 if UDM indicates subscription data change for network slicing
AMF starts timer T3550 if UE indicates support for network slice usage control and AMF determines to provide on-demand NSSAI
UE enters state 5GMM-REGISTERED and sets 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED
UE returns a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF
UE replaces the CAG information list

UE returns a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the operator-defined access category definitions, the extended local emergency numbers list or the "CAG information list"
UE returns REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge the reception of the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE
UE returns a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the UE radio capability ID IE or the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE
AMF stops timer T3550
AMF changes to state 5GMM-REGISTERED
AMF sends a REGISTRATION REJECT message to the UE

edges.description: Initial registration request is accepted by the network
5G-GUTI or SOR transparent container IE is included
Operator-defined access category definitions IE, the Extended emergency number list IE, the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE are included
UE has set RCMAP bit and Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE is included
UE is not in NB-N1 mode, has set RACS bit, and UE radio capability ID IE or deletion indication IE is included
AMF determines that the UUAA-MM procedure needs to be performed for a UE

UE has included the service-level device ID set to the CAA-level UAV ID in the Service-level-AA container IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, and if: - the UE has a valid aerial UE subscription information; - the UUAA procedure is to be performed during the registration procedure according to operator policy; - there is no valid successful UUAA result for the UE in the UE 5GMM context; and - the REGISTRATION REQUEST message was not received over non-3GPP access
AMF needs to update the NSSRG information and UE has set NSSRG bit
UE supports S-NSSAI time validity information and AMF needs to update it
UE supports S-NSSAI location validity information and AMF needs to update it
UE has set NSAG bit and RCMAN bit and NSAG information IE is included
UE supports network slice replacement and AMF determines to provide the mapping information
UDM indicates subscription data change for network slicing
UE indicates support for network slice usage control and AMF determines to provide on-demand NSSAI
Certain IEs present in REGISTRATION ACCEPT require acknowledgement

The REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE and the UE had set the CAG bit to "CAG supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message

The REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the Operator-defined access category definitions IE, the Extended emergency number list IE ,the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE

The UE has set the RCMAP bit to "Sending of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message for negotiated PEIPS parameters supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and if REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE
The REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the UE radio capability ID IE or the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE
Initial registration request cannot be accepted by the network
